args.body:
Hello Terrence,

We have verified your report regarding order ORD-6721 for the Weatherly rain shell. Since tracking has stalled and the package has not arrived, we have issued a full refund of $129.00 to your original payment method (Visa ending in 9906). Please allow 3-5 business days for the funds to appear in your account.

If you have any further questions or if the package eventually arrives, please let us know.

Best regards,
Customer Support

Hello Terrence,

Thank you for following up. I took a deeper look into the tracking status for your Weatherly rain shell (order ORD-6721). 

Because the carrier tracking had stalled in transit without updates since last Thursday and delivery was unconfirmed, we wanted to ensure you were fully taken care of right away, which is why we processed your full refund of $129.00. 

As for the physical parcel, when tracking flatlines like this for several days past the expected window, it typically indicates that the package has experienced a delay or misroute at the carrier's sorting facility. Since the refund is already complete, if the package does happen to show up eventually, you are welcome to keep it or pass it along on us as a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience.

Please let me know if there's anything else I can help you with!

Best regards,
Customer Support
